'''Calvaria''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who, in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], was the 18-year-old [[Prince/Legends|princess]] of [[Nallastia]]. Her mother was the [[Margravine]] [[Quenelle]], the [[Skull Queen]] of Nallastia, and she was raised in the [[Skull Queen's fortress]] on [[Mount Octan]].

==Biography==
When the parents of the child [[Klay Firewell]] were brought to the fortress of the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] [[Skull Queen]] to be condemned to sacrificial [[Prison/Legends|imprisonment]] within a megalithic [[Force field/Legends|energy field]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] took Calvaria hostage in order to bargain for their release. Skull Queen [[Quenelle]] acquiesced, and after helping Skywalker's Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] locate the [[Lost Stars of Nallastia]] to free Klay's parents, Calvaria was released.<ref name="skulls" />

Calvaria and Quenelle both professed a desire to [[Marriage/Legends|wed]] Kenobi, despite the former being betrothed to prince [[Alto]] of the [[Raptor Clan]]. Calvaria was truly in love, however, with a [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] named Rench, and secretly traveled to nearby [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] to meet with him. Brought up as Princess of the Skull Clan, she had always wondered how beings might regard her if they did not know she was royalty. While on a trade mission to Fondor she had met Rench and introduced herself as '''Klara''', an aide to the Margravine Quenelle, which wasn't so very far from the truth. Calvaria had not expected to fall in love with Rench, and she felt guilty for having deceived him about her true identity.<ref name="hostage">''[[Star Wars Adventures 3: The Hostage Princess]]''</ref>

Before Calvaria could tell him the truth after fleeing from [[Skull Queen's fortress|her mother's fortress]], however, the [[Fondor Spaceport|spaceport]] Rench worked at was taken over by [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. In the melee, Calvaria was abducted by the last [[FX-series medical assistant droid/Legends|FX medical assistant]] droid left standing after [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] took [[Mace Windu's lightsaber/Legends|his lightsaber]] to Groodo the Hutt's [[Droid Control Army]]. Quenelle and the Jedi [[Bultar Swan/Legends|Bultar Swan]], Windu, and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] at last liberated the spaceport, and Calvaria was rescued by Windu.

Back at her mother's fortress, the Princess rested in her chamber on what was to be her wedding day to Prince Alto, when a visitor called—it was her beloved, Rench the mechanic. He immediately disclosed to her that he had no idea that she was the Skull Queen's daughter, and she apologized for having deceived him, but he guessed that she had done so with the hope that Rench would fall in love with her only for her and not her regal position. He, too, then asked for her forgiveness, because his name, he revealed, was not in fact Rench, but Alto, Prince of the Raptor Clan. There would be a happy wedding that day, after all.<ref name="hostage" />
